product.title: Luxury Catamaran Whale Watching Cabo San Lucas

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this luxury catamaran looks for humpback whales from a double-deck boat with a guide and a hydrophone for whale song when animals are present. Snacks plus alcoholic and soft drinks are included so the morning stays on the water rather than a separate cafe stop. The published route covers the Cabo San Lucas coastline and the Arch, with an optional hotel transfer fee and a small cash dock fee at check-in. Seasonal whale presence still depends on winter migration, and the crew keeps a respectful distance from the animals. The format suits visitors who want a guided wildlife window without booking a private charter. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the marina, Arch, and Sea of Cortez water that shape this catamaran outing.
